honest_caveats: Godot scenes for Tower/Floor/Worker/Lift/OpenClaw/HUD/Penthouse/CommerceWing are minimal scaffolds — the actual tower is BUILT AT RUNTIME by TowerRenderer.gd / LiftRenderer.gd / etc instantiating real 3D meshes. This is the standard Godot pattern (script-driven scene composition).
Headless parse succeeded but does NOT prove the window opens — that requires a real display. The user must run ./scripts/qsb_godot_run.sh to confirm pixels.

Floor interior detail (Penthouse rooms, OANDA trade desks, Binance order desks) is rendered via the HUDController RichTextLabel selected-floor panel in V1. Per-room 3D interiors are scaffolded — to be filled in V2.
